plugins.name: ergana
plugins.description: The rules before each edit, a rules check before the agent says it is done, /ergana:add-decision to write, try and record a decision, /ergana:review for an independent review before a change lands, and /ergana:tracking to set where this repository's tickets go and which GitHub board shows them.
